metadata.name: Point_Ledger_Service
metadata.description: Multi-tenant point ledger service for earning, spending, reversal, and expiration processing.

glossary.definition: A balance holder that belongs to a tenant and an owner.
A posted action that contains one or more ledger entries.
A signed amount change applied to one account.
A granted point chunk with optional expiration datetime.
A mapping from a spend transaction to consumed lots.

fields.name: accountId
fields.description: Unique account identifier in tenant scope.

fields.name: tenantId
fields.description: Tenant identifier for strict data isolation.

fields.name: ownerType
fields.description: Owner type value such as USER or SYSTEM.

fields.name: ownerId
fields.description: Owner identifier that links account ownership.

fields.name: allowNegative
fields.description: Flag that controls negative balance permission.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Operational state such as ACTIVE or SUSPENDED.

fields.name: txId
fields.description: Unique transaction identifier.

fields.name: tenantId
fields.description: Tenant identifier for transaction isolation.

fields.name: txType
fields.description: Transaction type like EARN, SPEND, ADJUST, EXPIRE, or REVERSAL.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Transaction state such as POSTED or REVERSED.

fields.name: idempotencyKey
fields.description: Optional key used to prevent duplicate posting.

fields.name: postedAt
fields.description: UTC timestamp when the transaction is posted.

fields.name: entryId
fields.description: Unique entry identifier.

fields.name: txId
fields.description: Parent transaction identifier.

fields.name: accountId
fields.description: Target account identifier.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Signed amount where plus means credit and minus means debit.

fields.name: lotId
fields.description: Unique lot identifier.

fields.name: accountId
fields.description: Account identifier that owns this lot.

fields.name: sourceTxId
fields.description: Source transaction identifier for lot creation.

fields.name: originalAmount
fields.description: Initial lot amount at creation.

fields.name: remainingAmount
fields.description: Remaining lot amount after consumption.

fields.name: expiresAt
fields.description: Optional UTC datetime for lot expiration.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Lot state such as ACTIVE, CONSUMED, EXPIRED, or CANCELLED.

invariants.description: Sum of all entry amounts in one transaction must always be zero.
invariants.expression: Sum of all entry amounts in one transaction must always be zero.

invariants.description: Accounts with allowNegative set to false must never have a negative balance.
invariants.expression: Accounts with allowNegative set to false must never have a negative balance.

invariants.description: Remaining amount in each lot must stay between zero and original amount.
invariants.expression: Remaining amount in each lot must stay between zero and original amount.

invariants.description: Reversal transaction entries must be sign-inverted mirror of the source transaction.
invariants.expression: Reversal transaction entries must be sign-inverted mirror of the source transaction.

steps.description: Administrator or system grants points to a user account.
System optionally creates a lot when expiration is specified.
User spends points from a user account.
System consumes lots by FEFO ordering with deterministic tie-break.
System rolls back the transaction when balance is insufficient.
Authorized operator reverses a posted transaction.
System creates a reversal transaction with mirrored entry signs.
Batch process finds expired active lots.
System moves remaining amount to zero and posts expire transaction.

api.summary: Search accounts by owner and type.
Get account details with current balance.
Post EARN, SPEND, or ADJUST transaction.
Get transaction detail and linked entries.
List lots for audit and troubleshooting.
